name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: A strip of logos, quotes or cards that scrolls by itself in a seamless loop, with a pause button.

examples.name: marquee-demo
examples.title: Marquee
examples.description: A logo strip. Hover, focus inside it, or press the pause button to stop it.

examples.name: marquee-testimonials
examples.title: Two rows
examples.description: Quote cards in two rows travelling in opposite directions.

examples.name: marquee-badges
examples.title: Fast, without hover pause
examples.description: A quick strip of badges. pauseOnHover is off, so the pause button and keyboard focus are the ways to stop it.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the strip for screen readers, e.g. "Customers".

props.name: children
props.description: The items. Each child becomes one list item.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the items travel. The pace is the same however long the strip is.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Travel towards the end of the line instead of the start.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause while the pointer is over the strip.

props.name: pauseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the pause toggle.

keyboard.action: Moves into the items (which pauses the strip) and then to the pause button.
On the pause button, pauses or resumes.

notes: Meets WCAG 2.2.2 (Pause, Stop, Hide): a visible pause toggle, plus a pause on hover and while anything inside has keyboard focus.
Under prefers-reduced-motion nothing moves: the items wrap onto rows and the pause button is removed.
Screen readers get one copy of the items as a list inside a labelled region. The copies that make the loop seamless are aria-hidden and inert, so they can't be tabbed to.
Travels towards the start of the line, so it runs rightwards on right-to-left pages.

do: Use it for content people can skip: logos, quotes, highlights.
dont: Don't put anything a person must read or act on in a marquee.
Don't use more than two on one screen.
